address: 215 E. Main St., Lakeland, FL, 33801, USA
bio: It's fitting that this stylish, contemporary restaurant is located in the heart of Lakeland's downtown, as it's a hive of activity. Maybe it's the rooftop bar or maybe it's the Latin American-inspired menu, but Nineteen61 specializes in a good time. Kick things off on the roof before selecting from their large menu with plenty of Peruvian and Cuban influences. Expect dishes with plenty of spark, like house-made croquetas tucked with jamón serrano and Manchego cheese with guava sauce. Lechón asado served Cuban style offers a hearty portion of slow-roasted pulled pork with house-made mojo sauce with jasmine rice, black beans, yucca and crispy pork belly that is the very definition of comfort food.
